prompt:
Create one original transparent RGBA action sprite sheet for Paprika's JAMVERSE '96 basketball block. Paprika must match the established sprite identity: a REAL TINY FOUR-FOOTED KIT FOX, horizontal compact wild-fox body, russet-orange fur, cream-white muzzle/chest/underside, huge triangular ears, bright expressive eyes, pointed muzzle, large bushy tail with pale tip, and fitted purple-and-gold sports vest. Keep her small natural fox proportions. She always remains a quadruped with four animal legs and fox paws, never humanoid, never upright as a person, no human hands/arms, shoes, shorts, or cloak. Match polished richly shaded 1990s arcade pixel-sprite art with crisp dark outlines.

Draw EXACTLY four separate complete right-facing three-quarter full-body fox poses on a transparent RGBA sheet, arranged in a strict 2-column by 2-row grid in row-major order. Same scale and side angle. Give each pose generous transparent margins. Keep ears, muzzle, every paw and the full pale tail tip inside its cell. No touching, overlap, fused silhouettes, crop, duplicates, panel lines, borders, or background.

Action sequence for an animal-appropriate defensive block. The gameplay renders the separate basketball; draw no ball.
0) Paprika holds a low alert defensive stance on all four paws, head toward the incoming play, tail balanced.
1) She compresses her hindquarters and plants her forepaws, beginning a quick vertical spring while keeping her body horizontal.
2) APEX BLOCK at the high point: a short fox leap with both forepaws raised as unmistakable animal paws to deflect an invisible ball; all four legs remain fox legs, the muzzle and ears are expressive, tail balances the airborne body. Do not turn her into a biped.
3) She descends, lands on all four paws, and settles back into a guarded stance.

The figures are independent complete originals, not a progression made by moving limbs between copied drawings. Transparent background only. No ball or ball-like object, hoop, rim, net, floor, court, shadow, human, opponent, other animal, lettering, numerals, logos, glow, or equipment.

review.notes: Visual and source review confirms four separate full-body kit-fox poses in 2x2 row-major cells, transparent RGBA outside each figure, no ball or props, four-legged fox anatomy in every pose, consistent Paprika identity, and the forepaw-deflection apex in pose2 at runtime frame2/tick5.
